actions.name: hotkey_bind
actions.description: Register a global hotkey: an `id` other components subscribe by, bound to a key-combo `trigger` (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+Space) via the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal, falling back to a manual (inject-only) binding when no portal answers. Re-binding an existing id replaces its trigger in place.

id.description: Stable binding id consumers subscribe by (the daemon's DAEMON_PLUGIN_PTT_BINDING must match one). Re-binding an existing id replaces its trigger in place.

trigger.description: Key combo in operator spelling: MOD+MOD+KEY with Ctrl/Control, Super/Meta/Logo/Win, Alt, Shift modifiers and one non-modifier key (letters, digits, F1-F35, space, enter, arrows, XF86Audio* names, punctuation). Normalized to the XDG portal form at bind time.

description.description: Human label surfaced in desktop portal UIs and hotkey_list. Defaults to "hotkey <id>".

backend.description: portal = OS-level combo is live; manual = stored for inject/compositor wiring only.

actions.name: hotkey_unbind
actions.description: Remove a hotkey binding by `id`, freeing its key combo; idempotent — returns unbound:false (not an error) if the id was already gone.

unbound.description: False (not an error) when the id was already absent — unbind is idempotent like every stop primitive in this repo.

actions.name: hotkey_list
actions.description: List all currently registered hotkey bindings (id, trigger, description) plus which backend (portal/manual) is active.

actions.name: hotkey_status
actions.description: Report the active hotkey backend (portal/manual) and how many bindings are currently registered, without listing them.

actions.name: hotkey_inject
actions.description: Publish a synthetic hotkey_pressed/hotkey_released kernel event attributed to `binding` (any string, need not be a registered id) — this only fakes the internal 'this hotkey fired' signal for the manual backend (compositor exec wiring, tests, custom automation). It does NOT synthesize a real keystroke into the focused window or any application; its effect is limited to whatever other component is subscribed to that binding id's event (e.g. spuriously starting/stopping a push-to-talk recording).

binding.description: Binding id the event is attributed to. Does NOT need to be registered — inject is the manual backend's event source.

HOTKEY_PLUGIN_BACKEND.description: auto (default) tries the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal and degrades to manual when no desktop portal answers; portal demands it; manual never touches D-Bus.

HOTKEY_PLUGIN_BINDINGS.description: Boot bindings, semicolon-separated id=TRIGGER pairs in operator spelling ("ptt=Ctrl+Shift+Space;mute=Super+F9"). An invalid spec is logged and skipped — the plugin stays up with an empty store.
